title: A 3.8% drop
prompt: Last night's full run fetched 38,350 pages. Tonight's fetched 36,900. The source averages about 40 deletions a day. What does the connector do?

options.text: Finalize: the drop is below the 20% safeguard.
options.feedback: Below 20%, stale documents are deleted, not paused. The safeguard is not a completeness check.

options.text: Finalize, then re-add any missing pages in tomorrow's run.
options.feedback: Users lose those pages until the next run, and a bad successful crawl is not recoverable in the meantime.

options.text: Halt before finalizing, reconcile against tombstones and a source count, then rerun.
options.feedback: Right. 1,450 missing pages is far beyond normal churn. Never let a partial fetch finish as a successful full crawl.

takeaway: Compare against expected churn, not against the safeguard.
